text:
samir: quick sync — proposal for a new private offer with Nimbus HW + two SIs. need to lock commit cadence and renewal smoothing before we hand to legal.
elaine: can you paste the high-level structure? i'll ping legal after we align.
matt: prefer bullets — numbers matter for marketplace SKU mapping.
samir: high-level:
- term: 12mo commit
- pricing: spline-style commit tiers (onramp friendly)
- credits: decaying monthly "onramp credits" applied to invoice
- hw kicker: 3mo Dedicated capacity credit for qualifying customers
- SI enablement: 90-day engineering credits to partner for integration work
sophie: re: "spline-style" pricing — you mean progressive discounts as consumption ramps up?
samir: yes, exact idea: small entry bucket with higher discount that tapers to baseline as spend normalizes. helps close proofs and reduces sticker shock.
andy: gonna need a short example table for marketplace private offer UI. otherwise Ops will ask for SKU mapping.
samir: adding a tiny snippet for the pitch (paste to the PO form):
```
Tier A: first $50k -> 25% off, monthly-decay credits $5k
Tier B: next $150k -> 15% off
Tier C: >$200k -> 10% off (committed price)
Onramp credits: apply first 6 months, decrement 20% month-over-month
```
elaine: ok, that helps. question: how do we model renewals? auto-renew or opt-in with velocity smoothing?
matt: suggest auto-renew with a 6mo review window and right to rebalance up to +/-5% pricing if usage variance >30%.
sophie: need to ensure SI credits don't count towards Redwood revenue for renewal calculations — partner enablement should be off-invoice or marked as partner-credit.
andy: agree. also flag: marketplace private offers can't attach arbitrary partner SKUs easily — we'll need a separate partner credit line in the PO metadata.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace: Private offer draft created (PO-9321). Link: https://marketplace.example.com/po/PO-9321
samir: perfect. next items:
- legal: review PO language for onramp credit decay and hw kicker
- finance: confirm how partner credits are journaled and revenue recognition
- partners: confirm SI enablement scope and acceptance criteria (SOW)
elaine: i'll open a legal thread today. matt/andy can you draft the marketplace metadata fields (partner_credit_id, hw_kicker_period) so we can attach to PO-9321?
matt: on it, i'll drop a JSON snippet for the metadata.
andy: i'll double-check with finance re: recognition.
sophie: timeline? we have a joint announcement window with Nimbus in ~8 weeks — need PO signed 3 weeks before that to align PR and co-marketing materials.
amy: :thumbsup: (react)
samir: ok — owners noted. i'll consolidate and update the PO. thanks everyone.
